subject: Mobile Development
title: China's App Store Landscape
description: A quick win: understand China's App Store Landscape.

hook.text: Google Play is banned in China. So how do a billion Android users get their apps?

buildup.text: Dozens of Chinese app stores compete: Huawei AppGallery, Xiaomi, Tencent MyApp, and more.

discovery.text: Developers must publish to multiple stores, each with different rules and revenue shares.

twist.text: Chinese app stores collectively distribute more Android apps than Google Play worldwide.

climax.text: The world's biggest Android market runs without Google's involvement.

punchline.text: No Google Play? China built a dozen alternatives.

quiz.question: Why doesn't China use Google Play?
options: Google Play is banned in China
